description: Files embedded in a frozen Sparse-DFT GUI. Paths are relative to the resource root: sys._MEIPASS in a PyInstaller build, the repository root in a source checkout. Resolved at run time by sparse_dft.resources.

entries.source: build/ (or build/Release, build/RelWithDebInfo, build/Debug) when bin/<platform_tag>/ is absent

entries.note: runtime libraries of the native core (OpenMP, BLAS/FFT, MPI) copied next to the executables
reserved and empty in distributed builds. VASP POTCAR-derived PAW data is licensed and never bundled; users import their own sets into <user_data_dir>/paw/.
optional fonts registered with QFontDatabase before the platform font chain

worker.frozen: sparse-dft-worker[.exe] --worker JOB.json --status STATUS.json (console twin next to the windowed sparse-dft-gui; one-file builds use sparse-dft-gui --worker)
worker.process_tree: POSIX: new session, SIGTERM then SIGKILL to the group; Windows: Job Object with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, TerminateJobObject on cancel

manifest: packaging/make_manifest.py writes MANIFEST.sha256.json (sha256 and size of every bundled file) and verifies it with --check
